# WO-198: Refresh the developer CLI reference
Status: open (local scope prepared; owner tracker/worktree preparation pending)
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-builder
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Assigned to: Kai Nakamura
Source: WO-194 / `docs/vendor/CODEX_SITE_REFRESH.md`; replaces CP-37/#165

## Goal
Make the existing CLI reference easier to scan and understand without changing its command contract.

## Acceptance criteria
- Apply the reviewed scoped foundation, with clear command grouping, readable examples, and links to relevant developer guidance.
- Import `site-refresh.css` and wrap refreshed route content in `.site-refresh`; leave Header/Footer/Base untouched.
- Preserve every command, option, argument, example, source location, and requirement accurately against checked-in command data.
- Keep generated/build output script-free and avoid adding dependencies or product behavior.
- Add built-output assertions for rendered command cards and command paths, arguments, options, and source locations.
- Verify 320/360/768/1280 CSS px, Windows 125%/150% display scaling, 200% zoom, keyboard access, D6 contrast (body >=7:1; other >=4.5:1), and >=44px tap targets.
- Audit every claim against D8; flag any claim outside the allowed list.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `web/src/pages/developers/cli/index.astro`
- `tests/codex/test_cx_dev_cli_render.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope / do not touch
No CLI implementation, command schema/data, other developer routes, global styles, shared tokens, app, CSP, or dependencies.

## Required checks
- `cd web && pnpm build`
- `PYTHONPATH=src FREEMYID_REQUIRE_WEB_DIST=1 ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_dev_cli_render.py`
- `ruff check tests/codex/test_cx_dev_cli_render.py`
- `pnpm check` from `web/`

## Check-in plan
Owner-prepared worktree after WO-203 is integrated on main with reviewed WO-195/196. This is in the final page wave. CP-37/#165 is superseded; owner will close #165 when creating the replacement issue.

## Notes and decisions
This page is documentation of current behavior. If source and page disagree, document the mismatch; do not alter the command contract.
